title: A novel machine learning derived RNA-binding protein gene-based score system predicts prognosis of hepatocellular carcinoma patients
summary: Across nine GEO cohorts and TCGA, the score adds prognostic information alongside TNM staging in validation cohorts. These retrospective cohort associations do not establish treatment response or causal biology.
ai_technology: A LASSO-Cox RNA-binding-protein score stratifies overall survival in hepatocellular carcinoma and is tested across GEO and TCGA cohorts.
